key_highlights: Persistent inflation pressures hinder RBA rate cut expectations, creating headwinds for equity multiples.
Consumer discretionary sector weakens sharply with Harvey Norman reporting steep drops in foot traffic and profit.
Resources provide resilience as mining equities rebound alongside notable gold and critical minerals exploration progress.
Global equity volatility persists amid US tech turbulence, while the Australian dollar shows emerging signs of strength.

sectors.trend: Miners rebounding led by high-grade gold discoveries, resource expansions, and critical mineral processing deals.
sectors.implications: Mid-tier gold and manganese explorers provide uncorrelated upside; resource majors buffer broader index volatility.

sectors.trend: Severe downturn in foot traffic and earnings as cost-of-living constraints and housing corrections bite.
sectors.implications: High vulnerability for big-ticket household goods and discretionary retailers exposed to indebted consumers.

sectors.trend: Sticky inflation delays RBA easing cycle, supporting net interest margins but increasing credit risks and public scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Major banks face capped upside as lending volume softens and non-financial operational/reputational risks persist.

sectors.trend: Elevated volatility driven by US tech leadership turmoil, debt-fueled AI spending, and global valuation corrections.
sectors.implications: ASX technology stocks remain sensitive to international risk-off sentiment and US bond yield movements.

sectors.trend: Mongolian gas developments progress while grid transmission infrastructure advances and COP31 policy debates stall.
sectors.implications: Selective upstream gas momentum offset by broader decarbonisation transition frictions and mixed energy price dynamics.

sectors.trend: Targeted oncology clinical milestones reached alongside intensifying policy debate over private health insurance pricing.
sectors.implications: Biotech clinical trials offer idiosyncratic upside, whereas private health insurers face demographic subsidy pressures.

key_themes: Stagflationary headwind: Worse-than-expected inflation constraining RBA policy flexibility despite recession indicators.
Consumer retrenchment: Accelerating retail pullbacks compounded by regional property price corrections.
Resource defensiveness: Mining discoveries and gold safe-haven appeal acting as market stabilisers.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight highly leveraged domestic cyclicals; overweight cash-generative resource majors and defensive stalwarts.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Household Spending and Retail Earnings Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate from consumer discretionary into consumer staples and essential healthcare.
Maintain index protection via ^AXJO put options and allocate to gold equities as risk hedges.
Limit exposure to residential property developers and mortgage-heavy regional balance sheets.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight high-grade gold producers and strategic mineral explorers.
opportunities.rationale: Strong assay results, commercial processing agreements, and resilient bullion demand provide robust earnings support.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long AUD positioning against rate-cutting currencies.
opportunities.rationale: Australian dollar showing signs of life buoyed by persistent domestic inflation keeping RBA relatively hawkish.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Divest or underweight big-ticket consumer discretionary retailers.
defensive_moves.rationale: Harvey Norman's plunging foot traffic and profits confirm deepening consumer stress and discretionary retrenchment.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase allocation to defensive large caps and index hedges.
defensive_moves.rationale: Recession risks paired with delayed rate relief elevate multiple compression risk for broader equities.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain range-bound with a cautious tilt as hawkish RBA expectations cap equity valuation multiples.
market_outlook.long_term: Performance divergence will widen between resilient resource/defensive exporters and domestic cyclicals exposed to consumer slowdown.
key_catalysts: Australian CPI updates and RBA monetary policy statement
Domestic retail sales prints measuring discretionary contraction
US tech earnings stability and bond yield trajectory
Commodity price trends across iron ore, gold, and energy
watch_list: RBA cash rate futures market pricing
Discretionary retail trading updates and foot traffic metrics
ASX 200 (^AXJO) technical support levels around 200-day moving average
